meta.title: Future 16-19 cohort: pupils by national curriculum year, FSM and SEN
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from the January school census (all schools including independent for year-group counts); full count, no sampling error.
meta.limitations: Counts are by school location (LA where the school is), not pupil residence - Luton and Central Bedfordshire have material cross-border flows (Hertfordshire, Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire). Excludes home-educated and children missing education. FSM % and SEN % are state-funded secondary schools only; in Bedfordshire's three-tier areas middle schools are counted as secondary. The derived pipeline_aged16_* indicators are a simple cohort roll-forward with NO adjustment for migration, mortality, or movement into/out of independent schools - they indicate scale, not a forecast. Suppressed values (c/x/z/low) are null.

indicators.label: Pupils by national curriculum year (Y7-Y13)
indicators.description: Headcount of pupils in each NC year group, all school types, latest January census (breakdown = year group).

indicators.label: Pupils in Y7-Y11
indicators.description: Sum of NC years 7-11, all school types (history 2021/22 onwards).

indicators.label: Pupils in school sixth forms (Y12-Y13)
indicators.description: Sum of NC years 12-13 in schools (excludes FE/sixth-form colleges).

indicators.label: Derived: pupils reaching age 16 by academic year
indicators.description: DERIVED indicator. Cohort roll-forward of the 2025/26 census: pupils in NC year N are aged N+4 at the start of that year, so they are aged 16 at the start of academic year T when N = 12 - (T - 2025). E.g. today's Y6 is the cohort aged 16 in 2031/32. period/breakdown = target year (start of academic year). No migration/mortality adjustment.

indicators.label: Derived: 16-18 cohort size by academic year
indicators.description: DERIVED indicator. Sum of the three single-year cohorts aged 16, 17 and 18 at the start of target academic year T (the 16-19 study cohort), rolled forward from the latest census as for pipeline_aged16_by_year. Only years whose three cohorts are all still in Y1-Y11 today (full school coverage) are given - earlier years would rely on school-only Y12-13 counts that omit FE colleges. No migration/mortality adjustment.

indicators.label: % eligible for FSM (state-funded secondary)
indicators.description: Percentage of pupils in state-funded secondary schools known to be eligible for free school meals (January census).

indicators.label: % with SEN support (state-funded secondary)
indicators.description: Percentage of pupils on SEN support (no EHC plan) in state-funded secondary schools - indicates support needs in the future cohort.

indicators.label: % with an EHC plan (state-funded secondary)
indicators.description: Percentage of pupils with an education, health and care plan in state-funded secondary schools.
